label: Adaptive discovery repair on six unresolved Fourth Way targets: diagnoses, guided retries, controls
summary: Failure diagnosis and guided retry (#1833; scripts/discover_blueprint.py repair/retry, docs/discover.md, 'Adaptive repair') on the six Fourth Way targets left unresolved by #1826 and the #1832 pilot (attempts e63628f1, e8bf6def, and b979db99 for the #1848 sense tags). All runs at cf7a567a5 (main after #1848), Duper only, pool all; solver inputs keyed by the corpus, library and Discover scripts, not by the repair tool. CONTROL A, the original search with unchanged inputs (run-discovery.sh, 8 candidates, 100k heartbeats): 6 of 6 unresolved, 293 s run. CONTROL B, the same search with a larger budget (24 candidates, 300k heartbeats): 1471 s run; 64498e7e closed from f8ba2429 and d0fc96b7, filtered as known (e8a3eb51); a9622441 closed only from 6c27657f and 15c570f5, filtered as domain_by_name, senses (BEING_1/BEING_3, MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1/2/6) and witness, i.e. noise; 4 unresolved. GUIDED: 19 exact solver runs, 150 s of Lean time in total, at most four per target, each chosen by the planner from the diagnosis and recorded in the trace with its reason. Results per target. 64498e7e: the premises of e8a3eb51 close it, filtered as known; the split through 634a80b8 (route 400ba1f0) stays unresolved, the Cartesian frame-bound carriers W, B, T, R are not identified (tagging them is the open obligation); one-point countermodel of the 8-candidate bundle not found. 4c79298d: the premises of 4d1efe91 close it (minimization drops ee4ab504: known modulo excluded middle, which Duper's classical logic supplies); the 8-candidate bundle is jointly satisfiable in a one-point model, has no one-point countermodel and stays unresolved at 400k heartbeats (not refuted). The plain search misses it because retrieval eligibility admits neither MoreInIsAsymmetric a4814f25 nor MoreSuchHasThePerfectionReading c11369aa (attempt b979db99), not because of binding: with the #1848 tags every binder of the bundle is identified. eaa4c679: the premises of d27dd642 (result c9bdd003) close it, known modulo excluded middle; the reuse of e39a4fce (GodNamesTheUniqueMaximeEns) does not. 101bdd62: 5a948c37 closes it, known (8542e377); the engine's senses filter on that pair (MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1/6) stays the open definition-link question of attempt b979db99. 6c27657f: the premises of 1dff22d0 and of c201b61a, every binder identified, do not close within 100k heartbeats: a proof-search gap, not a binding or retrieval gap. Both routes use NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading 5cda1946, whose content is a WellFounded relation, and the verified proofs use well-founded reasoning that Duper does not search over opaque WellFounded. a9622441: the cogito route bfaf6f92 stays blocked on identification: the untagged MotionMapsBatch1 binders Occurs and Bears (ThinkerLives) and nobile, bonum, verum (LivingMoreNobleThanMerelyExisting, NobilityGradeConvertible) stay separate from the same-named binders of CogitoSubject and of the target; the reuse of e4e6b0cd (GradesToMaximumAtBeing) leaves its InAct, MoreIn, esse separate although they carry the same whole-binder tags, because their types are not definitionally equal to the target's. No one-point countermodel was found for any engine bundle, so a budget failure is not excluded for them; no diagnosis (e) was supported, and the engine's bridges (CausesIn x1 x2 x3 implies InAct x1 x3; PriorSimply x1 x2 implies IsGod x1; InAct x1 x2 implies IsGod x1) remain OPEN candidate propositions, as in #1826, not adopted. No new relationship: every closed goal composes from a verified argument, so nothing is registered. RUNNER FINDINGS. (1) A binder can carry both a whole-binder and a partial-application tag (CausalMapsBatch1.CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives.CausesIn: CAUSE_2 and CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 on _ _ esse); senseOf in scripts/Discover.lean takes the first tag, so the identification depends on tag order. The repair passes tags in the engine's order (records by id) and flags such binders; a first run with sorted tags left e8a3eb51 unclosed for that reason alone and was discarded. (2) An early version counted the wait for the heavy-job lock against the Lean time limit; its three timed-out 4c79298d runs were discarded and the limit now bounds Lean only. Neither discarded run is a solver outcome. AFTER #1850 (retrieval by whole-binder sense tags; excluded middle granted in the known filter to a proof using Classical.choice; measured in the #1850 PR body at the same options as control A): the plain search now gives 64498e7e known (e8a3eb51), eaa4c679 known modulo excluded middle (d27dd642, flagged implicit_excluded_middle) and 101bdd62 known (8542e377) with the senses flag, the closures the guided retries found here, which corroborates the retrieval diagnosis (b) for them. 4c79298d is proved there from a different bundle, 18561596 MaximumHasNoDistinctEsseCause, fad8af3e SomeBeingMaximalInBeing and 86d02b69 GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, but filtered domain_by_name because the Being/Respect carriers of TermSenseForks are untagged: new (c) evidence, an identification obligation, not a result. 6c27657f and a9622441 stay unresolved there as here. The repair's own known check now follows the engine's rule (excluded middle only for a classical proof); the three modulo-logic closures above used Classical.choice. A delivered repair mechanism establishes none of its targets.
blocker: Next tests: (1) engine: an exact --premise bundle for truth discover, so that its own filters and certification run on a repair goal; a binding rule independent of tag order; a reported distinction between heartbeat timeout and saturation; a shared universe-specialization helper for scripts/DiscoverRepair.lean (tag-based retrieval and the excluded-middle grant are delivered by #1850). For 4c79298d's known route a second retrieval hop over the senses the top candidates introduce (#1850 remaining gaps). (2) 6c27657f: give Duper the core lemma for well-founded relations (WellFounded.has_min or an equivalent minimal-element premise unfolded for the search) and retry the identified bundles of 1dff22d0 and c201b61a. (3) a9622441: review whole-binder tags for the MotionMapsBatch1 and CogitoSubject vocabulary of bfaf6f92, or record the cogito route as needing explicit bridges. (4) 64498e7e via 400ba1f0: tag or bridge the frame-bound CartesianAdequacy carriers. (5) 4c79298d via 18561596, fad8af3e, 86d02b69: review whole-binder tags for the Being/Respect carriers of TermSenseForks (or a bridge), then rerun.
